summary: Phase S2 survives the requested adversarial attacks at baseline 097545f1. Sixty-eight focused committed counterexamples pass across readiness, placement, SRS evidence/governance/queues, sparse planning, and package-contract boundaries; the probes are non-mutating, and no change remains in the four accepted engine packages.
evidence: Hard-gate compensation attack: v3-readiness-state proves an unmet hard prerequisite caps readiness even when other weighted prerequisites are strong, while the all-soft compatibility control remains bit-identical to v2.

Mean-versus-minimum retention attack: both the SRS remediation and owning-proficiency suites construct divergent reviewed variants and prove the objective decision consumes the minimum live retention rather than an average; unreviewed variants are excluded.
Small-sample cap bypass attack: the owning proficiency suite gives one variant only two attempts and proves its low confidence caps otherwise stronger aggregate evidence.

Reveal/severity loss attack: processReview receives every reveal step and maps the review to Again, while SubmissionSrsAdapter forwards severe misconception provenance into the rating mapper and review reasons.

Invalid replay, future-version, and non-finite input attacks: the SRS governance suite rejects malformed timestamps, empty provenance fields, future parameter major v999, and a 100001-row replay; public numeric-boundary cases reject NaN, Infinity, zero, negative, and above-one request-retention values.

FSRS governance bypass attack: calibration below 10000 reviews fails the volume gate, the accepted corpus deterministically splits 8000/2000, the candidate is compared with the incumbent, and release remains false without explicit humanReleaseApproved even when evaluation gates pass.

Placement boundary attacks: invalid start nodes and NaN budgets are rejected before provider invocation, a budget exhausted mid-node is non-converged, hard-parent ordering is enforced, and the traversal stalls only after four unchanged frontier probes accumulated across complete decisions.

Queue attacks: remediation-only input is retained when ordinary cards are absent, excess remediation truncates deterministically to maxReviewsPerDay, the combined queue never exceeds the cap, and ordinary reviews interleave by default after remediation.

Sparse threshold attack: a high-utility sparse candidate at readiness 0.79 is rejected against readyThreshold 0.80 while the boundary candidate is selected; injected utility records provider/version provenance and dense near-ready behavior remains compatible.

Package-contract attacks: the import contract verifies the exact approved export maps, builds every declaration/runtime target and loads each runtime export, and rejects any production import whose top-level package is undeclared or outside the provider-neutral allowlist.
The focused adversarial aggregate passes six files and 68/68 tests with one worker under UTC.

Post-probe checks find no 097545f1..HEAD drift, working-tree mutation, or diff-check failure in packages/knowledge-space-core, packages/knowledge-space-practice, packages/srs-engine, or packages/practice-core.
UX review is not applicable because these adversarial probes cover framework-neutral engine packages with no browser UI or route surface.
commands: TZ=UTC pnpm exec vitest run packages/knowledge-space-core/src/__tests__/v3-readiness-state.test.ts packages/knowledge-space-core/src/__tests__/v32-placement-boundary-remediation.test.ts packages/srs-engine/src/__tests__/phase-s2-srs-remediation.test.ts packages/srs-engine/src/__tests__/phase-s2-srs-correctness-remediation.test.ts packages/knowledge-space-practice/src/__tests__/v32-planner-integration.test.ts packages/__tests__/mastery-engine-import-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot (pass: 6 files, 68/68 tests)
TZ=UTC pnpm exec vitest list <the six focused files> (pass: 68 enumerated adversarial cases)
git diff --name-only 097545f1..HEAD plus git diff --check and git status --short scoped to the four engine packages (pass: no post-baseline drift or probe mutation)
